scope: The grader compares source-only complete traces for the four bounded #4102 cases. It never establishes runtime behavior, production truth, general completeness, or #4103/#4104 architecture.

validation: candidate case ids exactly match the nonempty public source-unit-manifest case vocabulary with no duplicates
each candidate record_manifest exactly matches the public record-manifest projection for its case
canonicalization deterministically validates producer-visible relation boundaries, annotation links, and rejection form without collection ordering
transport relation, unknown, contradiction, and span ids are rewritten from the public canonical source-to-IR contract before comparison
every accepted relation, unknown, and contradiction has at least one complete revision-bound source span
each relation unknown_ids and contradiction_ids value is a list of existing case-local annotation ids
extra relations score false and duplicate identifiers reject the candidate

deterministic_grader.candidate_invocation: uv run --script scripts/grade_controls.py --reference trace-reference.json --candidate candidate.json --source-replay-root source-replay --output <grading-output>
deterministic_grader.self_check_invocation: uv run --script scripts/grade_controls.py --reference trace-reference.json --candidates controls/control-candidates.json --source-replay-root source-replay --self-check
deterministic_grader.boundary: The adjudicator bundle receives a frozen canonical reference and a frozen candidate only after blind extraction. It derives blind case coverage from the nonempty public source-unit-manifest vocabulary, applies canonical-source-ir.json to the candidate for blind structural validation, and uses the frozen reference only for reference-semantic diagnostics. Blind acceptance may use only the public source-unit vocabulary, public record projection, canonical representation rules, and byte replay, including the public exact-J5-table action projection. A field, grouping, or rejection classification not deterministically derived from those producer-visible inputs is reported only by reference_semantic. It contains only the exact revision-bound source bytes required for span replay; it does not use raw-lane records, adjudications, historical receipts, or a control identifier as an independent verification oracle.

source_replay.method: For every quoted source span, resolve repository_path under source-replay/<candidate case source_revision>/ in the adjudicator bundle; compare source SHA-256 and exact UTF-8 byte slice before scoring. The source bundle materializer obtains each byte-identical file with git show at the declared revision and rejects a digest mismatch before delivery.
rejection_conditions: candidate source revision differs from the canonical case revision
a relation or annotation has no complete replayable source span

acceptance_threshold.receipt_requirement: A separately authored receipt must identify the SHA-256-bound candidate emitted by a fresh blind extractor, its blind_acceptance result, source-replay result, and complete record-integrity digest. Only that separately produced candidate can support an independent extraction or blind-acceptance claim.

reference_semantic_diagnostic.meaning: This strict frozen-reference comparison remains an adjudicator diagnostic. It is not a blind-extractor acceptance condition unless the compared payload is supplied by a public deterministic source/context/rule projection.

historical_receipts.wording: The retained immutable historical receipts cover six declared claim projections. They do not grade or independently verify the complete trace reference.
